# Mr. Big Guy: The Rise and Fall of Curtis Slade
> A raw, unfiltered street memoir told from inside a federal prison cell. Book 1 of the Slade Enterprise Group series. To be continued: Crown Me King.

## TL;DR
- **Title:** Mr. Big Guy: The Rise and Fall of Curtis Slade
- **Author:** Curtis Slade (a.k.a. Mr. Big Guy)
- **Publisher:** Slade Enterprise Group · Imprint: 1 Street Boyz Publications

- **Release date:** 2025-01-15
- **Genre:** Memoir · True Crime · Urban Literature

- **Format:** Hardcover · Paperback · Kindle · Audiobook (pre-order)
- **Pages:** 320

- **Audience:** Adult (18+)

## The Hook
"Everybody wants the crown... until they see the price."

## The Story
Curtis Slade was never supposed to make it out of Dania Beach. But the streets had a different plan. What started as a small-time hustle turned into a full-blown empire after Curtis and his crew — the First Street Boyz — pulled off a bloody robbery that shook Broward County and put a target on all their backs. Money started pouring in. Power came fast. And the name "Mr. Big Guy" began ringing louder than Curtis Slade ever did.

While Curtis is building his kingdom, the walls start closing in. His right man ain't no rat — but the woman he trusts most is hiding her own agenda. And from Miami, a ruthless Haitian kingpin is coming north, leaving bodies behind in search of what Curtis took.

Now loyalty is tested. Lines get crossed. And every decision could be his last.

"Because in this game... you don't lose when you die — you lose when you trust the wrong person."

## Origin
Raised in Dania Beach, Curtis's future was shaped by a conversation with his uncle, Greg Dees: "School isn't for you. Your future is out there in the streets. That's where you will become a bonafide gangster. That's where you'll earn your crown." Curtis became what the streets of Dania Beach, Florida nicknamed him: Mr. Big Guy.

## Themes
- Power and loyalty
- Betrayal and trust
- Rise and consequence
- Brotherhood and the cost of survival
- South Florida street noir
